name: finflow
description: FinFlow — Plataforma multiplataforma de finanças pessoais (Local-first ou Servidor Remoto)
author: Kane'e Sell <kanee.sell@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.build:mobile: npm run build:web && npm run sync --workspace=@finflow/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@finflow/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@finflow/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@finflow/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@finflow/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@finflow/shared && npm run test --workspace=@finflow/api && npm run test --workspace=@finflow/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace=@finflow/shared && npm run test --workspace=@finflow/web
scripts.verify: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
